purpose: Owner and team reference map for Fantasy Management.
rules: Use TeamID as the stable identity.
Use Metadata.json when exact owner mapping matters.
Use League.json for current team names, rosters, picks and salary context.
In human-facing analyses, rankings, tables, headings and recommendations, use each owner's preferred_human_label by default.
Refer to TeamID 1 as Robert, not merely as Mighty Giants, whenever the manager is being compared with Marcel, Flo, Jan, Dennis or Tim.
Use a team name alone only when the franchise identity itself is relevant, for example canonical team fields, matchup displays, logos, trade graphics or explicit team-name tables.
When both identities matter, use the form 'Robert (Mighty Giants)'.
Do not replace canonical machine-readable team_name values or historical source data with owner names.
